units.source_text: 此后源氏公子和头中将都写信给这位小姐。

en.t: After that, Prince Genji and the Captain both wrote letters to the young lady.

units.source_text: 然而都不曾收到回信。

en.t: Yet neither of them received any reply.

units.source_text: 两人都等得心焦，头中将尤其着急，他想：“此人太不解风情了。

en.t: Both men waited in anxious impatience, and the Captain was especially vexed, thinking, "This woman has far too little feeling for romance.

units.source_text: 如此闲居寂处之人，应该富有趣致。

en.t: Someone living so quietly and apart from the world ought to be full of taste and sensibility.

units.source_text: 看到一草一木之微、风雨晦明之变，随时可以寄托情怀，发为诗歌，使读者体察其心境，因而寄予同情。

en.t: At the sight of the smallest grass or tree, or any change in wind, rain, darkness, or light, she could entrust her feelings to poetry, letting the reader perceive her state of mind and feel sympathy for her.

units.source_text: 无论身份何等高贵，如此过分韬晦，令人不快，毕竟是不好的。”

en.t: However noble her rank may be, hiding herself away to such an excessive degree only displeases people and is, in the end, not good."

units.source_text: 两人本来无所不谈，头中将便问源氏公子：“你收到了那人的回信么？

en.t: Since the two men normally spoke to each other about everything, the Captain asked Prince Genji, "Have you received a reply from her?

units.source_text: 不瞒你说，我也试写了一封信去，可是音信全无。

en.t: To tell you the truth, I tried sending her a letter too, but there has been no word at all.

units.source_text: 这女人太无礼了！”

en.t: That woman is terribly rude!"

units.source_text: 他牢骚满腹。

en.t: He was full of complaints.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“果然不出我所料，他也在向她求爱了。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "Just as I expected, he too has been courting her."

units.source_text: 便微微一笑，答道：“唉，这个人，我本来不希望她回音。

en.t: He gave a faint smile and answered, "Ah, as for that woman, I never expected any answer from her in the first place.

units.source_text: 有没有收到，也记不清了。”

en.t: Whether I received one or not, I no longer remember clearly."

units.source_text: 头中将猜想公子已经收到回信，便恨那个女子不理睬他。

en.t: The Captain guessed that the prince had already received a reply, and he resented the woman for ignoring him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子呢，本来对这女子并无深情，加之此人态度如此冷淡，因此早已兴味索然。

en.t: As for Prince Genji, he had never felt deeply for this woman, and since her manner was so cold, his interest had long since faded.

units.source_text: 现在得知头中将向她求爱，想道：“头中将能说会道，他只管去信，深恐这女人爱上了他，搭起架子来，将我这个首先求爱的人一脚踢开，这倒是很可悲的。”

en.t: Now, learning that the Captain was courting her, he thought, "The Captain is eloquent, and if he keeps writing to her, I fear this woman may fall in love with him, put on airs, and cast aside me, the one who courted her first. That would be rather sad."

units.source_text: 他便认真地嘱托大辅命妇：“那小姐音信全无，拒人于千里之外，实在教人难堪！

en.t: So he earnestly charged Taifu no Myobu, "That young lady sends no word at all and keeps people at a great distance. It is truly embarrassing!

units.source_text: 大约她疑心我是个浮薄少年吧。

en.t: She probably suspects that I am a frivolous young man.

units.source_text: 我其实决不是个薄倖郎。

en.t: In truth, I am certainly not a heartless lover.

units.source_text: 只有女的没长心，另抱琵琶，半途里把我抛开，反而归罪于我。

en.t: It is only women who are fickle, take up someone else, abandon me halfway, and then blame me instead.

units.source_text: 这位小姐无拘无束，独居一处，没有父母兄弟来干涉她。

en.t: This young lady is free and unrestrained, living alone, with no parents or brothers to interfere with her.

units.source_text: 这样无须顾虑的人，实在是最可爱的。”

en.t: Someone who need not worry about such things is truly the most lovable."

units.source_text: 大辅命妇答道：“这倒也不见得。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu replied, "That is not necessarily so.

units.source_text: 你把她那里看作温柔乡，毕竟是不相称的。

en.t: For you to regard her place as a haven of tender love is, after all, not quite fitting.

units.source_text: 不过这个人腼腆含羞，谦虚沉静，倒是世间少有的美德。”

en.t: Still, her shyness, modesty, and quiet reserve are virtues rarely found in this world."

units.source_text: 她把自己所见的情况描述给公子听。

en.t: She described to the prince what she herself had seen.

units.source_text: 公子说：“那么，她大约不是一个机敏干练的人。

en.t: The prince said, "Then she is probably not a quick-witted or capable person.

units.source_text: 然而像小孩那样天真烂漫，落落大方，反而可爱。”

en.t: Yet if she is as innocent and open as a child, that makes her all the more lovable."

units.source_text: 他说这话时心中回想夕颜的模样。

en.t: As he said this, he was recalling Yugao's appearance in his heart.

units.source_text: 这期间源氏公子患了疟疾，又为了藤壶妃子那件事，怀着不可告人的忧愁，心中烦忙得没有休息的时候。

en.t: During this time Prince Genji suffered from malaria, and because of the matter concerning Lady Fujitsubo, he carried a secret sorrow and his heart was so troubled that he had no time for rest.

units.source_text: 一春已尽，夏天也过去了。

en.t: The whole spring came to an end, and summer too passed by.
